raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions keeps 4582 POSTED rows, but gold_region_daily uses an inner join to silver_customers, and raw_customers only has zero-padded IDs (C00001-C00200). Some transactions, mostly in later batches, use short IDs such as 'C8' and 'C110', which fail to match and are dropped (4582 - 4248 = 334). Normalizing customer_id to the 'C' + 5-digit zero-padded form in silver_transactions should restore the join.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(customer_id, '^C[0-9]+$') THEN 'C' || lpad(regexp_replace(customer_id, '^C', ''), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
